author: Axiom I
title: Station Environment Probe and Deterministic RNG Baseline
abstract: Probes the execution environment, imports shared seed utilities, verifies deterministic RNG across Python and NumPy, and tests file I/O to shared storage. Writes a concise JSON summary and a NumPy array artifact to shared storage for others to inspect and build upon.
